source.title: Prevent orphan app-server processes on Symphony cancellation
source.objective: Address the reproduced Symphony v0.0.3 cancellation path that left a child app-server and sleep process alive after the root issue became terminal.

work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "Symphony v0.0.3 cancellation lifecycle can orphan the child app-server process: in an end-to-end local memory-tracker test with a blocking fake app-server, moving the issue to terminal state removed it from Symphony running state and deleted the workspace, but the child PID 2312685 remained alive and reparented to the user service manager for >18 seconds with its own sleep child.
